name: Heartbeat
description: For an array $$$u_1, u_2, \ldots, u_n$$$, define a prefix maximum as an index $$$i$$$ such that $$$u_i \gt u_j$$$ for all $$$j \lt i$$$; a suffix maximum as an index $$$i$$$ such that $$$u_i \gt u_j$$$ for all $$$j \gt i$$$; an ascent as an index $$$i$$$ ($$$i \gt 1$$$) such that $$$u_i \gt u_{i-1}$$$. You are given three cost arrays: $$$[a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n]$$$, $$$[b_1, b_2, \ldots, b_n]$$$, and $$$[c_0, c_1, \ldots, c_{n-1}]$$$. Define the cost of an array that has $$$x$$$ prefix maximums, $$$y$$$ suffix maximums, and $$$z$$$ ascents as $$$a_x\cdot b_y\cdot c_z$$$. Let the sum of costs of all permutations of $$$1,2,\ldots,n$$$ be $$$f(n)$$$. Find $$$f(1)$$$, $$$f(2)$$$, ..., $$$f(n)$$$ modulo $$$998\,244\,353$$$.
input_specification: The first line contains an integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1\le n\le 700$$$). The second line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$a_1,\ldots,a_n$$$ ($$$0\le a_i \lt 998\,244\,353$$$). The third line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$b_1,\ldots,b_n$$$ ($$$0\le b_i \lt 998\,244\,353$$$). The fourth line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$c_0,\ldots,c_{n-1}$$$ ($$$0\le c_i \lt 998\,244\,353$$$).
output_specification: Print $$$n$$$ integers: the $$$i$$$-th one is $$$f(i)$$$ modulo $$$998\,244\,353$$$.
approach_summary: Transform coefficient polynomials to point-value form via FFT/NTT in O(N log N). Multiply point values in O(N) and invert back to achieve fast polynomial convolution.
